{{Top}}
{{Quote|A hovertrain leads directly to the loading door.|[[LE-BO2D9/Legends|LE-BO2D9]] to [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (video game)">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (video game)|''Shadows of the Empire'' game]]</ref>}}
[[File:Crisis_on_Umbara.png|thumb|right|250px|A hovertrain on Umbara]]
'''Hovertrains''' (also '''hover-train''', '''bullet car''', '''maglev train''', '''maglev car''', '''levtram''', '''replusortrain''', '''repulsor train''' or '''magnetic-lift train'''<ref name="CTD">{{JournalCite|7|Countdown to Disaster}}</ref>) were [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] vehicles with a [[Repulsorlift generator/Legends|repulsorlift generator]] in the main cockpit pod and in every wagon connected behind, and can run over a single rail track, or hung below rail tracks.

Powered by a central generator and used to connect several point in a [[City/Legends|city]] for different purposes, they carried immense loads of cargo like ammo, supplies, personnel or used for public transportation.

The train could carry [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] guns on specialized carriages to defend its crew and cargo.

==History==
{{Quote|Borokki makes jumping a hovertrain sound easy. Maybe she should try it while under attack by Kage Warriors.|[[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]]|<ref name="The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Imp_Hovertrain_CSW10.jpg|thumb|right|250px|An Imperial hovertrain on Aridus]]
Hovertrains were used on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] as pedestrian [[Transport/Legends|transports]], which traveled between stations like [[Elcor Station]].<ref name="SW:OW">[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan (video game)|''Star Wars: Obi-Wan'']]</ref> During the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was escorted by [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] and [[Stass Allie/Legends|Stass Allie]] in a civilian hovertrain to an underground shelter to escape [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].<ref name="CW24">{{CW|24}}</ref> Such trains also saw service with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], on worlds such as [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]], [[Aridus/Legends|Aridus]] and [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. A special type of this transportation used by the Empire was called the [[armored hovertrain]].

One hovertrain was also used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] on [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] to deliver supplies to a [[Nayli|city]] controlled by [[Kohl Seerdon]], all the while being guarded by [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] from [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]] that attempted to prevent the train from reaching the city.<ref name="RS">[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron (video game)|''Star Wars: Rogue Squadron'']]</ref>
